dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you talking about, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: Fontaine, of course, Fontaine! The Palais Mermonia, our energy situation, our top-down system... We have so many problems here. Can't you see?

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: I've spoken to Arouet about them many times, and he agrees with my points — why, he's even treated me to coffee several times!

dialogues.speaker: Gontharet
dialogues.text: It's just that... Well, that hasn't worked as well recently. He says that my opinions don't attract him the way they used to.
